item: R111 step T2 rest: group, topic and bulletin readers follow the shipped list
key_paths: src/analytics/supergroup_stats.py src/api/insights.py src/analytics/source_topics.py src/bulletin/coverage.py src/bulletin/stories.py src/bulletin/articles.py
summary: A keyword the shipped stoplist hides no longer counts in a group's totals, its rising test, the Observatory sky or drill-through (one resolver for the panel and the sky), in the source topics (filtered in SQL so COUNT(DISTINCT article) stays right), or in the bulletin's coverage columns, story keyword sets and article keywords (dropped before the cut; the coverage fetch widens). The 13 shipped ring terms already on the list made the curated-group omission wrong. Only the list hides in group and topic readers, not the length rule. AI keywords left on purpose.
